method_note: FAST mode, one round. F-001 to F-020 reused from articles/2026-11-17-bali-wedding-packages/02-research-A.json and 02-research-B.json, renumbered; each keeps its ORIGINAL checked date and its original ID in source_ref. Live quotes replace em and en dashes with commas or hyphens.

facts.claim: Our packages page says: "Every package is fully curated: the venue, the ceremony setup, an on-the-ground planner, photography, and accommodation for you and your guests". FAQ adds: "Specific inclusions vary by resort and are sent through after you enquire".
facts.source_name: Wedded Wonderland, All-Inclusive Destination Wedding Packages
facts.use_note: Own brand page. Always pair with 'inclusions vary by resort'.

facts.claim: Packages page inclusions table: Ceremony venue and styling, Dedicated planner and concierge, The couple's accommodation = 'Included in every package'; Photography = 'Included, or arranged at preferred rates'; Guest accommodation = 'Paid separately, usually at negotiated group rates'; Legal and documentation = 'Paid separately, destination-dependent'; Extras such as spa, excursions or additional events = 'Paid separately, on request'. FAQ adds flights are typically paid separately.
facts.source_name: Wedded Wonderland, All-Inclusive Destination Wedding Packages
facts.use_note: Best single source for 'what is and is not included'. The same page's list says guest travel is 'coordinated' and legal requirements 'handled'; that means arranged, not paid for (A F-002).

facts.source_name: Wedded Wonderland, All-Inclusive Destination Wedding Packages
facts.use_note: Akohara is the only villa-style property in the edit. No prices or guest numbers shown.

facts.claim: Bali destination page venues: Nirjhara Bali Waterfall Weddings, Conrad Bali, AYANA Bali, Grand Hyatt Bali, Alila Villas Uluwatu, Jumeirah Bali, Samabe Bali Suites & Villas. Areas: Uluwatu (clifftop), Seminyak and Canggu (beachfront), Nusa Dua and Jimbaran (resort).

facts.source_name: Wedded Wonderland, Weddings in Bali
facts.use_note: A batch ruled the page's whole cost block unsourced and conflicting with our cost guide (F-008 'Do not use'). The villa line is the only villa price on our site; hold for Nic (N-03 / N-201).

facts.claim: Nirjhara Bali Waterfall Weddings (Tabanan) listing: Resort Exclusivity up to 60 guests USD 28,000 (two-night buyout of all 25 units). IDR 10,000,000 refundable security deposit per event; music ends 10 PM for non-buyout events; fireworks need hotel approval and police and village permits. Capacity 150 seated.
facts.source_name: Wedded Wonderland venue listing, Nirjhara
facts.use_note: Re-read today in F-100 range. USD only; Nic signoff on any price.

facts.claim: Our 2026 cost guide (planner Nicky Almeida, 'All figures in USD'): hidden costs include banjar (local community) fees, generator hire, overtime, corkage, wet weather marquees, government taxes and service charges. Suppliers usually take 30-50% deposit, balance 30-60 days before. Premium venues book out 12-18 months ahead.
facts.source_name: Wedded Wonderland, Bali Wedding Cost: The Complete 2026 Guide
facts.use_note: Own editorial quoting a third-party planner. Banjar fees are planner opinion; no official source for amounts (see F-200 range).

facts.claim: Concierge page describes 'Venue sourcing and planner recommendations', 'Guest travel and accommodation concierge', and states 'We are not a traditional wedding planner'. It discloses: 'When a client books with one of our partners, the partner may pay Wedded Wonderland a booking fee.'
facts.source_name: Wedded Wonderland, Destination Wedding Planner & Concierge
facts.use_note: CONFLICT: Bali page calls concierge 'complimentary'; concierge page sells it from US$5,500. Use 'free Discovery Call' only until Nic resolves (N-02).

facts.claim: Legal at home, celebration abroad: Australia has no marriage licence; the formal step is giving a Notice of Intended Marriage (NOIM) to an authorised celebrant at least 1 month and no more than 18 months before the wedding. A couple outside Australia can complete it with an authorised witness overseas.
facts.source_name: Attorney-General's Department, Get married
facts.use_note: Route most villa couples use: legal at home, symbolic villa ceremony. Present as an option, not advice. Confirmed by the Attorney-General's Department guidance and your celebrant.

facts.claim: Overseas marriages cannot be performed by an Australian-authorised marriage celebrant or registered in Australia; an overseas marriage is generally recognised in Australia if it was valid in the overseas country and would have been valid here (Marriage Act 1961, Part VA).
facts.source_name: Attorney-General's Department, Get married
facts.use_note: A villa ceremony led by an Australian celebrant, or a package 'celebrant' (F-101), is symbolic unless the Indonesian legal process (F-012) is followed.

facts.claim: Australian Embassy Indonesia: 'Under Indonesian Law No.1 of 1974 concerning marriage (the 'Marriage Law'), both parties must hold the same religion, if not, one party must convert to the other religion.'
facts.source_name: Australian Embassy Indonesia (DFAT), Marriage in Indonesia
facts.use_note: Confirmed by the Civil Registry Office (Catatan Sipil) where you marry and the Australian Consulate-General Bali.

facts.claim: Australian Embassy Indonesia: for non-Muslim marriages couples lodge a Notice of Intention to Marry with the Civil Registry Office at least 10 days before the wedding, and the marriage must be registered there afterwards to be legal. Documents include a CNI from the Australian mission with jurisdiction (for Bali, the Australian Consulate-General Bali), passports, birth certificates, divorce or death papers if applicable, and four 4x6cm photos. Requirements can vary by province.
facts.source_name: Australian Embassy Indonesia (DFAT), Marriage in Indonesia
facts.use_note: Confirmed by the Civil Registry Office of the regency where you marry (Badung, Gianyar, Tabanan) and the Australian Consulate-General Bali.

facts.claim: Australian Embassy Indonesia: 'Neither DFAT nor its missions overseas can advise on other countries' specific requirements for Australians to get married overseas.' It can be difficult for foreigners without Indonesian language skills to liaise with the Civil Registry Office and celebrants, and the Embassy suggests engaging a Wedding Organiser if unsure.
facts.source_name: Australian Embassy Indonesia (DFAT), Marriage in Indonesia
facts.use_note: Do not imply the Embassy endorses any organiser.

facts.claim: Bali Provincial Government (Love Bali): 'Foreign Tourists levy are subject to Rp 150,000 per person', paid once, cashless only, before entering Bali or at counters at Bali's airport and port, or at registered endpoints including hotels. Smartraveller confirms it is separate from the e-VOA or VOA.
facts.source_name: Bali Provincial Government, Love Bali FAQ
facts.use_note: Guest information pack line. IDR official fee, not AUD.

facts.claim: Smartraveller Indonesia: e-VOA and VOA cost IDR 500,000 (e-VOA adds a small online processing fee), valid for a 30-day stay, extendable once for up to 30 days; complete an arrival card and e-VOA on the All Indonesia website; at least 6 months passport validity from the dates you enter and leave Indonesia, plus a return or onward booking.
facts.source_name: Smartraveller (DFAT), Indonesia travel advice
facts.use_note: Guest-facing. IDR official fee; no AUD conversion sourced.

facts.claim: Smartraveller Indonesia: weather conditions can change quickly during the wet season, usually around October to April; flooding, landslides and mudslides occur regularly during the wet season.
facts.source_name: Smartraveller (DFAT), Indonesia travel advice
facts.use_note: Supports villa wet-weather cover point (F-105). No monthly climate data sourced.

facts.claim: Bali hub page today has no villa section and lists no private villa venue. Villa wording on the page: intro 'Clifftop ceremonies, beachfront villas, and five-star resorts, planned for you'; 'Budgets range from around AUD $5,000 for an intimate celebration to $50,000 or more for a luxury villa or resort event'; cost list 'Private luxury villa: villa hire from around $1,500 per night; full estate events up to $40,000+'; 'Catering: roughly $50 to $90 per guest at resorts and villas'. All seven venue cards are tagged Resort or Hotel. The page still calls the Wedded Concierge 'complimentary'.
facts.source_name: Wedded Wonderland, Weddings in Bali
facts.use_note: Re-read today: unchanged from A F-007/F-008. Villa cost line is unsourced and was ruled 'do not use' in the 2026-11-17 pack; hold for Nic (N-201). Do not imply we list private villas in Bali.

facts.claim: Nirjhara listing (Tabanan, tagged 'Resort'): 'With 25 standalone suites and villas and the option to reserve the entire resort, your closest friends and family can stay together and enjoy a celebration that unfolds over several days.' Resort Exclusivity offer: 'Up to 60 guests. Two-night buyout of all 25 units, up to 2-day venue use, flowers and reception lighting. Includes welcome drinks, 1-hour non-alcoholic drinks, approx. USD 83.82 net dining credit per person for 60, celebrant, planning, rehearsal, wedding specialist, sound system and couple's massage', USD 28,000.00 starting from.

facts.claim: Nirjhara noise and house rules: 'Music must end by 10 PM for non-buyout events. No music curfew applies with an exclusive resort buyout.' 'Nirjhara manages event sound levels.' 'Outside food and drinks are not permitted; exceptions for food require prior approval.' 'Fireworks require hotel approval and valid police and village permits.' 'An IDR 10,000,000 security deposit is required per event, refundable after any applicable deductions.' 'Ceremony and dinner venues depend on weather and guest numbers.'
facts.source_name: Wedded Wonderland venue listing, Nirjhara Bali Waterfall Weddings
facts.use_note: Venue rule, not law. 'Police and village permits' is the venue's wording; no official source found today for that permit process (N-203). Note the page's catering block says 'In-house only' and also 'External suppliers are welcome'; avoid stating caterer policy.

facts.claim: Nirjhara capacity and spaces: 150 seated overall; The Garden 100 seated / 150 standing; Ambu 65 seated / 80 standing; Lounge 50 seated / 65 standing; The Waterfall 2 seated / 6 standing; Yoga Shala 4 seated / 6 standing. 'What's covered' lists Wedding Coordinator; Flowers, Decor and Lighting; Dining and Drinks; Spa Experience; Sound and Photography Access; Balinese Wedding Traditions. Smaller offers: Intimate Wedding by the Waterfall up to 12 guests (two nights in 6 suites and villas) USD 9,000; Scenic Tropical Wedding up to 20 guests (two nights in 10 suites and villas) USD 13,000; Balinese Wedding Ceremony for 2 with 'a Hindu priest-led ceremony' USD 2,000.
facts.source_name: Wedded Wonderland venue listing, Nirjhara Bali Waterfall Weddings
facts.use_note: Overnight accommodation for 60 at a 25-unit property implies shared units; do not state beds per guest. Balinese priest-led ceremony is not stated to be a legal marriage (see F-016 legal route).

facts.claim: Alila Villas Uluwatu listing (Pecatu, Badung; tagged 'Hotel'/'Resort'): 200 seated; catering 'In-house only'; 'The resort provides comprehensive wedding services, gourmet dining options, and luxurious accommodations for newlyweds and their guests.' No price, offers, curfew or exclusive-use terms shown. Samabe Bali Suites & Villas listing (Nusa Dua, Badung): 300 seated; catering in-house; 'Samabe provides personalized wedding planning services, upscale catering, and exclusive use of their suites and villas for luxury destination weddings.' Lists 'all-inclusive luxury' and private beach access. No price or curfew shown.
facts.source_name: Wedded Wonderland venue listings, Alila Villas Uluwatu and Samabe Bali Suites & Villas (https://weddedwonderland.com/venue/samabe-bali-suites-villas)
facts.use_note: Both are resorts with villas, not private villas. Samabe 'exclusive use of their suites and villas' is ambiguous (not stated as whole-property buyout); do not call it a buyout.

facts.claim: Our venues guide on resort vs villa: 'a resort brings its own vendors, menus and coordinator; a villa brings you freedom and a blank slate you must staff. Neither is cheaper by default.' 'A private villa or estate hands you the keys and nothing else: total freedom over vendors, menus, timings and days, and total responsibility for sourcing all of it.' 'by the time catering, hire, power, staffing and wet-weather cover are priced in, the villa's freedom is usually a premium, not a saving.' Questions to ask include 'What exactly is exclusive to us: which spaces, for which hours, and who else is on the property that day?' and 'What are the noise, curfew and amplified-music rules, and are they council-imposed or negotiable?'
facts.source_name: Wedded Wonderland, Destination Wedding Venues: The Curated World Shortlist (Mark Tuason)
facts.use_note: Own editorial, not Bali-specific. Good internal link and framing for 'what a villa package includes'. Page date not shown; author byline shown.

facts.claim: Akohara Buahan Village Retreat has no venue profile on our site: /venue/akohara returned HTTP 404 and a Firecrawl map for 'akohara buahan bali villa' found it only on /destination-wedding-packages and /destination-packages. Packages page line: 'In the highlands above Ubud, Buahan trades Bali's beach crowds for river valleys and rainforest canopy.'
facts.source_name: Wedded Wonderland, All-Inclusive Destination Wedding Packages
facts.use_note: No capacity, curfew, staff or inclusion detail for Akohara on our pages (N-202). Do not link a venue profile for it.

facts.claim: Badung Regent Regulation (Peraturan Bupati Badung) No. 2 of 2017, Appendix, lists the licences the Head of the Badung One-Stop Investment and Licensing Service (DPMPTSP) signs on the Regent's behalf. Under 'Bidang Usaha Penyedia Akomodasi' (accommodation provider businesses) it lists: Hotel (star and non-star), camping grounds, caravan stops, 'Villa', and other accommodation (condotel, rental house). The same list includes 'Panggung Terbuka' (open stage) under night entertainment and 'Penyelenggaraan Pertemuan, Perjalanan, Insentif, Konfrensi, Dan Pameran' (MICE) as separate business fields.
facts.source_name: Badan Pemeriksa Keuangan RI legal database, Peraturan Bupati Badung No. 2 Tahun 2017
facts.use_note: Authority: Regent of Badung / DPMPTSP Badung. Shows only that in 2017 a villa run as a tourism accommodation business in Badung was a licensed business type. It says nothing about weddings or events at villas. Low: it is a 2017 delegation regulation and has probably been overtaken by Indonesia's national risk-based licensing (OSS RBA), which was not read (N-204). At most write 'villas operating as tourist accommodation are a licensed business category in Badung'; better to omit or use only as background.

legal.summary: Legal at home route: NOIM to an authorised celebrant 1 to 18 months ahead, then a symbolic villa ceremony in Bali. Confirmed by Attorney-General's Department guidance and your celebrant. source_ref B F-109.
Australian celebrants cannot perform overseas marriages; recognition under Marriage Act 1961 Part VA. Confirmed by the Attorney-General's Department. source_ref B F-107.
Same-religion rule under Law No. 1 of 1974, per the Australian Embassy. Confirm with the Civil Registry Office and the Australian Consulate-General Bali. source_ref B F-114.

Non-Muslim marriage: notice to the Civil Registry 10 days ahead, registration afterwards, CNI from the Consulate-General Bali. Confirm with the regency Civil Registry Office. source_ref B F-115, F-100.

2017 Badung regulation lists 'Villa' as a licensed accommodation business type; no official rule found on wedding or event permits at private villas, banjar contributions or noise. Authority to confirm: DPMPTSP Badung (or Gianyar/Tabanan equivalent) and the local banjar or desa adat via the venue.
